doctrine: Posterior update of the IMMUTABLE blind (grp15.json). The blind stays the core predictor; MBO/L1 flow adjusts ONLY where causal evidence is material. Never a replacement forecast. Both my days are R3 Friday-carry Mondays in the blind - I test whether MBO flow confirms carry-down or shows a deep-book shakeout/reversal.
data_quality_note: Across BOTH my days every feature-state row carries stand_down_reason 'mbo_mapping_flags' and execution_authority is NEVER granted (0/73 rows 0316, 0/71 rows 0323). Per doctrine piece 8 the reconstructed BOOK is not trustworthy here: queue depth, far_side_recruitment and the 1-min imb_level/imb_flow tick series get REDUCED authority. Trades remain valid, so I lean on the TRADE-FLOW phase structure (signed flow x price change x volume) + session turns, and LABEL the book limitation. Weak book data must not create false precision - confidence capped accordingly. This is SHADOW throughout.
cross_day_finding: Both Mondays are the SAME microstructure at different scale: an overnight thin-book SHAKEOUT UP (0316 +490 to 02:21; 0323 +1270 to 03:52) printed on NON-confirming flow (ph0 sflow -493 / -26 while price rises = divergence, not real buying), which REVERSES before/through the 06-10 ET catch-up window into a violent carry-DOWN (ph1: -930 on 43k vol / -1920 on 58k vol), then a late buy-flow phase (ph2 sflow +959 / +2409). The DISCRIMINATOR is ph2 absorption: 0316's late buying was ACCOMMODATED (price +140, close off the low, absorb_session False) while 0323's was ABSORBED (price -290 despite +2409 buy flow, absorb_session True) so the close pinned near the low. The blind's flagged monday.window_deep_book_shakeout ('needs the live 06:00 book') is now RESOLVED by the MBO: the shakeout is an overnight UP head-fake that PRECEDES the carry-down, it does not invalidate the R3 carry thesis.
